description: Defines data structures and constants related to 3GPP RRC (Radio Resource Control) reconfiguration procedures within the ocudu::ocucp namespace, including configurations for security, radio bearers, and measurement procedures.

classes.name: rrc_srb_to_add_mod
classes.description: Represents configuration for adding or modifying a Signaling Radio Bearer (SRB) in RRC reconfiguration.

classes.name: rrc_cn_assoc
classes.description: Represents core network association information in RRC procedures.

classes.name: rrc_drb_to_add_mod
classes.description: Represents configuration for adding or modifying a Data Radio Bearer (DRB).

classes.name: rrc_security_algorithm_config
classes.description: Holds security algorithms configuration for RRC security procedures.

classes.name: rrc_security_config
classes.description: Contains security configuration including algorithms and keys.

classes.name: rrc_radio_bearer_config
classes.description: Configures radio bearers for RRC reconfiguration, including lists of SRBs and DRBs.

classes.name: rrc_master_key_upd
classes.description: Represents master key update information in RRC procedures.

classes.name: rrc_delay_budget_report_cfg
classes.description: Configuration for delay budget reporting in RRC.

classes.name: rrc_recfg_v1530_ies
classes.description: Contains optional information elements for RRC reconfiguration version 15.30.

classes.name: cu_cp_ue_cho_candidate
classes.description: Represents a candidate for UE handover in cell change order procedures.

classes.name: rrc_reconfiguration_procedure_request
classes.description: Encapsulates a request for RRC reconfiguration, including bearer and measurement configurations.

classes.name: rrc_ue_capability_transfer_request
classes.description: Placeholder for UE capability transfer request structure.

classes.name: rrc_ran_area_cfg_t
classes.description: Configuration for RAN area including TAC and area codes.

classes.name: rrc_ran_notification_area_info_t
classes.description: Variant type for RAN notification area information.

classes.name: rrc_resume_request_response
classes.description: Response structure for RRC resume request.

methods.name: contains_values
methods.description: Checks if the radio bearer configuration contains any values.
